question: On ASML's second-quarter 2026 results call (July 15, 2026), what full-year 2026 growth did management say it expected for (a) memory-related net system sales, (b) EUV net system sales and (c) Installed Base Management sales, and roughly how many Low NA EUV systems did it expect to ship in 2026?
grading: Key points (all required): (a) memory-related net system sales to grow by OVER 75% in 2026; (b) EUV net system sales growth of OVER 45%, on around 65 Low NA EUV systems shipped in 2026; (c) Installed Base Management sales to grow OVER 30% in 2026. Accept 'more than'/'over' phrasing; do not accept ranges that replace the thresholds. Optional supporting items (not required): advanced Logic foundry-related net system sales >25%; non-EUV system sales ~+25% on ~130 immersion shipments; China ~20% of 2026 net sales. Fail if the answer substitutes the EUR 43-45bn FY2026 sales range, the 30% 2027 capacity increase, or Q3 guidance for these growth rates, or uses statements from the Q3 2026 results (October 2026, after the as_of date).
answer: (a) Memory-related net system sales expected to grow by over 75% in 2026; (b) EUV net system sales growth of over 45%, with around 65 Low NA EUV systems expected to ship in 2026; (c) Installed Base Management sales expected to grow over 30% [W02-E1]. Also on the call: advanced Logic foundry-related net system sales >25%, non-EUV system sales ~+25% (about 130 immersion DUV shipments) and China about 20% of 2026 net sales [W02-E1]. None of these growth rates appears in the press release or presentation, which give FY2026 net sales of EUR 43-45bn, gross margin 54%-56% and the 2027 capacity plans [W02-E2, W02-E3].
